title: Excellent Tour - need more time at site
text:
Our tour guide, Luke, was excellent. He entertained us we lots of information about Montserrat both historical and antidotal.  The sacristy visit was very informative even though we weren’t given the typical tour due to too many activities happening at the monastery that day. It is my opinion that this was Monserrat’s mishandling of scheduling and not the tour operators fault. 

I would have loved to have had more time to explore Monserrat. We had a tight schedule to keep in order to get to all the places scheduled. We did not have time to walk any of the paths or explore the market.
author: maryy371
